newsitem.title: USA: Nassau County, NY exec proposes trimming workforce.
newsitem.headline: Nassau County, NY exec proposes trimming workforce.

text.p: Nassau County, New York's executive, Thomas Gulotta, on Thursday proposed another early retirement plan to help further trim the county's workforce, which has approximately 14,000 employees.

"Nassau County has already made significant cuts in its workforce enabling the county to cut or freeze county property taxes for five consecutive years and in seven of the past eight years," said Gulotta, in prepared remarks.

A spokesman for the county executive, Dave Vieser, said that about 224 workers would be eligible under the new plan, which would have to be approved by the county legislation and the state. He could not quantify the potential savings that could be reaped as that would depend upon how many individuals opted to retire.
The new plan, if approved, likely would have about the same terms as previous plans, Vieser added.
